entries.zh: 裸身下来（脱光衣服下地）；落薄
entries.en: to come down stripped/naked; to descend bare
entries.notes: desmuelado 17世纪义近『脱去外衣/裸露』；落溥 音写与西语语义对应较间接，存推断。

entries.zh: 低头；落头
entries.en: to lower the head; bow the head

entries.zh: 跌价；落价
entries.en: to lower the price; fall in price
entries.notes: 闽栏后半 giam cheu lion 等音段 T99 污损难辨，仅主干 lo que 可据。

entries.zh: 落钱；钱价跌落
entries.en: the money/price falls; to drop in value

entries.zh: 摆（灯）：放下或提起灯
entries.en: to set down or hang up the lamp
entries.notes: 单字擺对 Bajar y ſeuir a la lampara 全句，语义按摆弄灯盏推断。

entries.zh: 放绳垂下东西（如吊筐、绳索带灯下来）；擺落城（城疑为绳义用字）
entries.en: to let something down by rope, e.g. a basket or a lamp on a cord
entries.notes: 西语词头有残（a p[残]elona）；城 用字存疑，按 sia 对绳类义推断。

entries.zh: 降旗；放旗
entries.en: to lower the flag; strike the flag

entries.zh: 摆上去（向上挂放）；擺上去
entries.en: to put or hang up; set aloft
entries.notes: 西语词头 Bajar firando lo amcon del 拼写不明（amcon 疑有误读）；据汉字与闽音 luy loeng chiu cu 释为向上挂放。

entries.zh: 如雷电骤降；（字疑为『災』）降灾
entries.en: to strike down suddenly, like lightning; calamity descends
entries.notes: 汉字标注 炎/災 存疑；chay 音近灾（tsai），按降灾义推断。

entries.zh: 灾祸骤降，如飞石与风暴；灾害
entries.en: misfortune to come down like stones and tempest; disaster
entries.notes: 汉字 炎害 疑为 灾害 之讹；害 hay 音义相合。

entries.zh: 降：自天而降，或霎时降临显圣（如上帝）；降
entries.en: to descend, as from heaven, or to come down suddenly in glory, as God
entries.notes: 闽栏 cang huã 等 T99 污损，降字主干与西语义清楚。

entries.zh: 降凡：从天降到人间；降凡（凡字存疑）
entries.en: to descend from heaven to earth; incarnation/descent to the mortal world
entries.notes: 汉字标注 凡/仜 存疑；闽音 luan 与凡相合，天主教语境降凡义明确。

entries.zh: 降下；落下来
entries.en: to come down; descend low

entries.zh: 降世（指降生于世间）；降世
entries.en: to descend into the world; come into the world (of Christ's advent)

entries.zh: 降痰（化痰下气，兼治窒息）；降痰（痰字存疑）
entries.en: to bring down phlegm; relieve choking (medical sense)
entries.notes: 汉字标注 痰/疾 存疑；闽音 tam 与痰相合，医学语境明确。

entries.zh: 降职；贬为小官（职字存疑）
entries.en: to demote; to be reduced to a lesser office
entries.notes: 汉字标注 職/戓 存疑；闽音 chit 与职相合，西语义清楚。

entries.zh: 降临：自天而降；降臨
entries.en: to come down from heaven; descend (advent)

entries.zh: 覆（俯首垂下头）；覆
entries.en: to bow the head; to bend down the head
entries.notes: 音写 paf 结尾 -f 为17世纪道明会记鼻化/塞尾习惯；覆字对低头义相合。

entries.zh: 翻滚而下；覆彜轉（彜字存疑）
entries.en: to come down tumbling, turning over and over
entries.notes: 汉字 覆彜轉 组合罕见，彜 字存疑；据西语 dando bueltos 及闽音 pag lin huỹ 推断为翻滚坠落。

entries.zh: 叩首至地以示敬爱与礼；款（俯伏拜地）
entries.en: to bow the head to the ground in token of reverence and love; to prostrate
entries.notes: 汉字 款 与义不甚合，闽音 cuan tan 或为 磕叹 类词之别写，据西语义定为俯首至地之礼。

entries.zh: 叩（低头叩拜）；叩
entries.en: to bow the head; to knock the head (in obeisance)

entries.zh: 叩首：低头行礼；叩首
entries.en: to bow the head, make reverence; to kowtow
